svg.text: Telemetry stays inside the lab network and is forwarded only to the Splunk Manager.
The live console and management API are bound to loopback for local analyst use.

g.text: UTM Virtual Network | 192.168.64.0/24 | Splunk Telemetry, Detection and Attack Simulation
Role: Monitored endpoint, SSH test target
Role: Indexer, search head, receiver, live console host
Index: soc_capstone · SignalScope & API bound to 127.0.0.1
Analyst uses Splunk Web for searches and dashboards.
SignalScope reads Splunk through the management API.
• Sysmon + Windows Security, System, Application logs
• Central storage in the soc_capstone index
• Attack simulations, detections, live trace console
• Live console bound to loopback (local analyst only)
